class.name: SteamOverlay
class.brief_description: Opens Steam overlay panes and observes when the overlay has focus.
class.description: Get this facade from [method SteamClient.overlay] after starting the client. Call it on the main thread. A retained facade becomes unavailable when its owning client stops. The SDK overlay must be enabled and loaded for the running game. For a direct development launch, pass [code]--crimson-steam-overlay=<AppID>[/code] after Godot's [code]--[/code] separator and launch with the matching Steam AppID. An open method returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK] once it issues the request to Steam. Observe the rendered pane to confirm its contents. [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY] means the overlay is not ready or the method was called off the main thread. [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE] means the facade or required SDK interface is unavailable. [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] means a live facade rejected a target.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns the latest activation state observed for the running AppID. The initial state is false until the current Steam runtime receives an activation event. A detached facade returns false.

method.name: is_ready
method.description: Returns true when the running Steam client reports that the overlay is loaded and accessible. It may remain false during graphics startup, with the overlay disabled, or in a headless process.

method.name: open_achievements
method.description: Requests the current game's Steam Achievements pane.

method.name: open_profile
method.description: Requests the Steam Community profile of an individual account identified by its decimal SteamID64.

method.name: open_store
method.description: Requests the Steam Store page in browse mode. Zero selects the running AppID. A positive unsigned 32-bit AppID selects another product.

method.name: open_trade
method.description: Requests the Steam Trading pane for the supplied partner's decimal SteamID64. Call it after the game's authorized backend has started an existing Steam trading session with that individual account.

method.name: open_web
method.description: Requests a page in Steam's overlay browser. Supply an absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL without embedded credentials and at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes.

signal.name: activation_changed
signal.description: Emitted when Steam reports that the overlay gained or lost focus. Applies to both a Steam hotkey and an in-game request. [method is_active] already reflects the new state when the signal is delivered.
